title: Ahead of tough new U.S. sanctions, Iran criticizes 'extraterritorial sovereignty'
summary_full: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Thursday that the proposed economic measures will likely negate the need for major U.S. military operations.
